title: Why a feed is not updating
excerpt: Troubleshoot product feeds that appear stale or have stopped updating.
author: FeedOps
content:
Feeds can stop updating when the source connection changes or an import is blocked.

## Check the feed status

- Confirm the source connection is still active.
- Review the most recent import time.
- Check for permission or authentication warnings.
- Confirm product data has changed in the source platform.

## Next step

Reconnect the source if permissions changed, then run another import.
